status: source qualification only; no measured carrier-field claim
length_provenance: Author filtering_v2.m uses dh=0.4 mm and l=30 dh; method definition is the liquid bore, not the gas annulus.
density_provenance: Nominal water density assumed for the 25 C qualification subset, not a measured dataset field.
viscosity_provenance: Air dynamic viscosity parameter from author's sample script, reused for the 25 C qualification condition.
prefilter: Three scaled median absolute deviations in diameter, after finite/positive and laser-wavelength checks. Applied only to the gas proxy, never to the full liquid source.
count_screen_meaning: Preliminary sample-count flag only, not statistical independence or sufficient accuracy.
time_block_method: Leave one equal-duration arrival-time block out and re-estimate the nominal proxy. Report ranges as sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
cumulative_diagnostic: Rice-rule diameter bins; cumulative speed standard deviation peak restricted to populations >= minimum_count_screen.
constraints: Source-only loader must reject downstream bodies before reading them.
Preserve original selected-record masks and all iteration histories.
Speed is the magnitude of two measured channels, not a full three-component speed.
Report signed component statistics separately; Y traverse second channel is tangential.
No probe-volume, sampling-velocity or detection-efficiency correction is implied.
No isotropic third component or SGS energy is inferred from these statistics.
